timeline.summary: The kentsu conquer Kusho after initial resistance.
timeline.quote: After meeting with some initial resistance, the kentsu conquered the island

citation.text: "Marhault Elsdragon", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Kentsu strike Kusho; Ayesha is captured by Gosta's defenders and escapes with Ramirez's help.
timeline.quote: Ayesha is captured by the island's defenders

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Meha creates a chasm to block Kushoan reinforcements, and Hage, who wanted to slaughter them, nearly kills Meha as punishment.
timeline.quote: Meha creates a chasm to prevent Kushoan reinforcements from reaching the battle.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo and Kei go to Sekana, where the Nekoru Wasitora agrees to let the Kentsu pass if they avoid her kittens.
timeline.quote: She will if the soldiers stay well away from her newborn kittens.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elsdragon lands on Kusho and finds it nearly empty; Gosta was only buying time to evacuate.
timeline.quote: Gosta was only fighting the Kentsu to buy enough time to evacuate the island.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Warbeard torches an evergreen tree so the rebels cannot communicate, then gives Kei and Tor vague orders to wander the island.
timeline.quote: Warbeard tells them he knew the tree could be used by Magnus to contact Gosta

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kei and Tor find Gosta's hidden lair, where he is terminally ill from mana poisoning, and meet Ramirez.
timeline.quote: Kei and Tor find the hidden lair of Gosta Dirk, who is now terminally ill from the mana poisoning of Kusho.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Halfdane, who had posed as Tor, mortally wounds Kei and Xira poisons Tor.
timeline.quote: Halfdane mortally wounds Kei, and Xira poisons Tor.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kei uses his last power to heal Tor.
timeline.quote: Kei uses his last power to heal Tor.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kei has a vision of Lady Orca murdering Kusho; Tetsuo realizes it is a trap but travels to Kusho with Tor and Ayesha.
timeline.quote: Tetsuo realizes it is a trap of Lord Overdark's creation but has to journey to Kusho to protect his honor

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo's group defeats Kusho's defenders and discovers Arien was never there and Orca has left for Argenti.
timeline.quote: The defenders are defeated, and Tetsuo discovers Arien was never on Kusho

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As punishment Tor is separated from Tetsuo and put to work in the kentsu under Barktooth Warbeard, who has been replaced by Halfdane.
timeline.quote: As punishment for failing to quell the uprising in the Edemis, Tor was separated from his master Tetsuo and put to work in the kentsu

citation.text: "Tor Wauki the Younger", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xira strikes Tor down while Halfdane in Tor's guise shoots Kei dead; Kei's last healing spell saves Tor.
timeline.quote: Kei, though, had the power to cast a single healing spell as his last action in life, curing Tor and saving his life from Xira's attack

citation.text: "Tor Wauki the Younger", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tor wakes from his coma and secretly rebels against Halfdane's cruelty.
timeline.quote: he was secretly rebelling against the vicious acts of Halfdane in Barktooth Warbeard's guise

citation.text: "Tor Wauki the Younger", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha returns, and with Kasimir's help she and Tor lure Halfdane into a trap by swapping appearances.
timeline.quote: through trickery where Ayesha cast an illusion spell on herself and Tor, swapping their appearance

citation.text: "Tor Wauki the Younger", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha and the grown coral reefs force the Kentsu to leave Kusho.
timeline.quote: decide to leave

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha cures Kusho of black mana poison and goes with Tor to seek Halfdane.
timeline.quote: Ayesha uses a seed she got from Magnus to cure the black mana poisoning on Kusho

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha traps Halfdane in a frozen pond and Tor destroys him with a black spell.
timeline.quote: Tor casts a black spell to destroy the shapeshifter.

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha is kidnapped by Kusho's defenders, then escapes with Ramirez DePietro's help.
timeline.quote: She escaped from the rebels with the help of Ramirez DePietro

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha falls ill from black mana crystals poisoning Kusho's mana lines, the work of Halfdane in disguise.
timeline.quote: Ramirez was the shapeshifter Halfdane , a minion of Ramses Overdark, in disguise.

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha freezes the water around Halfdane and Tor kills him with a black spell.
timeline.quote: Ayesha managed to freeze the water around him

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha and Tor reunite with Tetsuo and persuade him to become imperial champion again.
timeline.quote: they convinced him to take up the role of imperial champion once more

citation.text: "Ayesha Tanaka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orca attacks Kusho on her way to Argenti.
timeline.quote: Kusho was only attacked by Orca on her way to Argenti.

citation.text: "Kusho", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gosta and Kasimir stay behind to delay the Kentsu while the island evacuates; Kusho is overrun.
timeline.quote: Kusho was overrun by the Kentsu, who stationed an occupation force there led by marshal Barktooth Warbeard .

citation.text: "Kusho", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha uses the Sylvan Library to enhance the corals and decimate the Kentsu.
timeline.quote: Ayesha Tanaka used the Sylvan Library to enhance the corals around Kusho to decimate the Kentsu forces.

citation.text: "Kusho", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Halfdane plants black mana crystals to poison Kusho's mages; Gosta falls ill.
timeline.quote: Gosta himself had fallen seriously ill.

citation.text: "Kusho", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Umezawa is misled into fighting Edemi champions and is imprisoned by Ohabi Caleria.
timeline.quote: resulting in his imprisonment

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Umezawa defeats Lady Orca, escapes imprisonment and stabilizes Kei in the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: Umezawa ultimately managed to defeat Lady Orca

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ayesha Tanaka leads a counterattack that destroys much of the Madaran fleet and liberates Kusho.
timeline.quote: securing the liberation of Kusho

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Madara-Edemi War Halfdane is sent to Kusho to poison its manalines with black mana crystals.
timeline.quote: Halfdane was sent to Kusho to poison its manalines with black mana crystals made by Overdark

citation.text: "Halfdane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Halfdane kills Barktooth Warbeard and takes his place to infiltrate the kentsu.
timeline.quote: Halfdane killed Barktooth Warbeard and took his place to infiltrate the kentsu

citation.text: "Halfdane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Posing as Warbeard then Ramirez DePietro, Halfdane lures and ambushes Tor and Kei with Xira Arien; Kei is killed and Tor wounded.
timeline.quote: In this incident, Kei was killed and Tor wounded

citation.text: "Halfdane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tor and Ayesha Tanaka cure the manalines and fight Halfdane; Ayesha freezes the water so his reflections mesmerize him and Tor kills him with black-mana magic.
timeline.quote: Then Tor cast a black-mana spell to kill him.

citation.text: "Halfdane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Kusho Kasimir allies with Gosta Dirk and guards the island in the Madara-Edemi War, fighting Tetsuo again.
timeline.quote: Kasimir acted as Kusho's guardian, even fighting Tetsuo again.

citation.text: "Kasimir", section "Defending Kusho". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Marhault Elsdragon beats Kasimir, blasting a hole through his torso; Kusho's waters and Ragnar save him.
timeline.quote: Elsdragon had blasted a hole through his torso

citation.text: "Kasimir", section "Defending Kusho". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kasimir guards the ill Gosta and nearly kills himself fighting Halfdane.
timeline.quote: The hermit nearly killed himself fighting the shapeshifter

citation.text: "Kasimir", section "Defending Kusho". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kasimir brings Ayesha Tanaka and Tor Wauki a message to leave Kusho after killing Halfdane.
timeline.quote: they should get off Kusho as soon as they had killed Halfdane

citation.text: "Kasimir", section "Defending Kusho". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo's entourage, Kei included, is forced to join the kentsu as punishment.
timeline.quote: was forced to join the kentsu as punishment

citation.text: "Kei Takahashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kei and Tor look for evergreens and find Ramirez DePietro protecting the sick; Halfdane, posing as Tor, attacks Kei.
timeline.quote: was the shapeshifter Halfdane

citation.text: "Kei Takahashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kei and the real Tor are mortally wounded; Kei uses his last energy to heal Tor, giving up his own life.
timeline.quote: Kei used the last of his energy to heal Tor

citation.text: "Kei Takahashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Shasido Mayasi loses to Tetsuo Umezawa for the imperial champion title and lives as a hermit on Kusho.
timeline.quote: he chose to live out his life as a hermit on Kusho

citation.text: "Kentsu", section "Generals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Warbeard is killed and replaced by the shapeshifter Halfdane.
timeline.quote: Warbeard was killed and replaced by the shapeshifter

timeline.summary: The Chelonians suffered heavy casualties in the Madara-Edemi War but a population remained on Kusho.
timeline.quote: They sustained heavy casualties in the Madara-Edemi War
